text:
mika: heads up — planning an unpin of runtime 2.14 -> 3.0 canary tonight 23:00 PT. we saw a quantized long-seq regression in eu-west. propose staggered waves + sdk lock. objections?

jonah: which models are affected?

mika: quant-v4b and llama3q longseq. reproduce: kvcache mismatch then oom during warmup. logs uploaded.

sasha: recommend region-scoped model pin in eu-west for 12h instead of global runtime pin. less blast radius.

pratik: also consider pinning the quant model variant to a stable build. avoids runtime routing changes for unrelated traffic.

mika: agree. also want to lock sdk to 1.7.2 for canary callers to avoid new batching semantics. @devx can you issue comms?

devx: drafting a short advisory now. will post release notes and docs snippet.

mika: deploybot, apply model pin eu-west 12h.

deploybot: Executing:
```
/deploy pin model quant-v4b-stable --region eu-west --ttl 12h --initiator=mika
```

deploybot: Success — pin applied. pin-id: pin-1757601122-eu. Affected routes: /generate (quant-v4b, llama3q-longseq).

jonah: monitoring p50/p95 and 5xx.

sasha: runbook: if oom persists after model pin -> soft rollback runtime to 2.14 in eu-west. who owns rollback?

pratik: i'll own rollback execution and monitoring. add me to oncall for the window.

mika: checklist before escalation:
1) confirm metrics warm within 10m
2) kvcache warm logs (kvcache:warmed=true)
3) no 5xx increase for canary
4) snapshot traces (trace id prefix: canary/17576)
5) postmortem placeholder /notebooks/incident-1757601122

ivy: uploaded heap dump and jstack to s3://redwood-debug/1757601122/

jonah: green at +12m on p95 and no new 5xx. monitoring continues.

pratik: rollback command ready but holding:
```
/deploy rollback runtime 3.0 --region eu-west --force --reason "canary oom"
```
Note: ensure no runtime DB migrations before rollback.

mika: leaving pin until scheduled unpin. deploybot scheduled unpin for us-west 02:00 PT. post one-line updates: green/hold/fail.

devx: posted advisory to #release-notes and updated docs: "sdk 1.8.x changes batching semantics — pin canary callers to sdk 1.7.2 until compatibility checks finish."

ivy: heap analysis indicates transient warmup spike, not leak. attaching summary.

mika: thanks all. closing thread pending unpin or rollback.
